name: Porto Azzurro (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Porto Azzurro (quartered with towers and anchors) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Porto Azzurro, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Porto Azzurro arms — quartered with towers and anchors, crowned, within branches
